notes.title: ZORATHARION OUT
notes.content:
[h1]🚀 ZORATHARION IS NOW AVAILABLE! 🚀[/h1]

🎉 After months of development (9+ so far!), I'm super proud to announce that Zoratharion is finally available on Steam! 


[h1]An intense space roguelite[/h1]
Choose your pilot, your ship, your weapon, and dive into an intergalactic war where every run is unique. Dodge gunfire, upgrade your build, and take on fearsome bosses in your quest to liberate enemy systems!

Main features:
⚡ 4 pilots with unique abilities
🚀 4 ships with different play styles
🔫 A wide arsenal of weapons and power-ups
💥 Nervous battles 
🛸 Waves of enemies and epic bosses


[h1]💛 A BIG THANK YOU![/h1]
This game is my first independent project, and I'm incredibly grateful to everyone who has supported me throughout this adventure. Your encouragement and patience have enabled me to make Zoratharion a reality.

I sincerely hope you enjoy the game as much as I enjoyed creating it. Don't hesitate to share your feedback, stream your runs and share your score!

We can keep in touch in Discord, Twitch or instagram for next updates!

Enjoy the flight!
